Rina (PM): Quick idea: run a 4-week pilot we9ll call "Wayfinder" to validate onboarding friction, minimal observability, and partner-driven launch gates. Target 3 partners. Thoughts?
Marco (Eng): short pilot helps. we need 1-page quickstart + 1 command smoke test. can reserve 1 GPU per partner wk2-3.
Dee (Solutions): Acceptance gates recommendation: 1) smoke test success in 5 business days, 2) telemetry in console (95p latency, errors), 3) partner runs a 50-query eval.
Liam (Design): will make a 3-question weekly pulse and a short setup checklist. keeps partner time low.
sec-bot: Note: security questionnaire required before keys; DPA if regulated data.
Rina (PM): Incentives: waived infra for pilot + 3 office-hours. Recruitment: direct invites; open form if slots left after 72h.
Marco (Eng): Action items: quickstart repo (Marco), intake form (Dee), pulse template (Liam), sec flow check (sec-bot). deliverables in 48h.
Rina (PM): Nice. Success signals: 80% onboarding in 5 days, avg pulse >=4/5, one partner shows conversion interest. I'll draft invite tonight and post here.
